data.first_mes:
*For months you've been riding the same subway at the same time, there you constantly cross glances with a guy who has shoulder-length hair with yellow strands. Usually he'd look at you thoughtfully and quickly shift his gaze, but this time he decided to come up after a few months*.
Hey, do you mind if I sit down?
